description.value: MR MIKES is a Canadian steakhouse casual chain with a Langford, BC location serving premium steaks, burgers, pastas, and shareable appetizers in a relaxed, come-as-you-are atmosphere. Founded in 1960 and revitalized under the 'SteakhouseCasual' concept, it positions itself as a community gathering spot welcoming locals and tourists alike. Touring cyclists will find full dine-in service alongside takeout and delivery options.

address.value: 985 Whirlaway Crescent, Victoria, British Columbia, V9B 6W6, Canada

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the OSM address (985 Whirlaway Crescent, Victoria, BC V9B 6W6), phone (250-590-3222), and that this is an actively operating steakhouse restaurant with dine-in, takeout, and delivery. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, Wi-Fi, washrooms, etc.) are mentioned anywhere in the website content, so those fields remain null.
concerns: OSM name 'Mr Mikes' differs slightly from the brand's own styling ('MR MIKES' or historically 'Mr. Mike's'), though this is a minor formatting inconsistency only.
Website lists the address city as 'Victoria' rather than 'Langford'; the Langford municipality is commonly grouped under the Greater Victoria metro area, so this is likely not an error.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, actively operating full-service restaurant with a confirmed address, phone, and website. A useful stop for touring cyclists seeking a sit-down meal or takeout in the Langford area.
